title: A tourist leaves a fat wallet on Wen's counter. Wen looks at you: 'Your kind knows what to do with these.'

options.label: Chase the tourist down
options.get: 40 clout and a very confused hug
options.cost: 10 Energy and your reputation for being slippery

outcomes.text: You catch him at the escalator. He hugs you and cries a little. Wen watches the whole thing with his mouth open.

later.text: Remember the wallet at Downstairs on Main? Wen tells everyone. Your dumplings come with a free extra now, and people nod at you.

options.label: Lighten it a little first
options.get: C$220 from a stranger's vacation fund

outcomes.text: C$220 lighter, the wallet goes back to the tourist. Wen says nothing and gives you exact change from now on.

title: Sgt. Bev, off duty, buys you a coffee: 'Somebody's fencing scooters off 31st. You'd know. Help me out once.'

options.label: Tell her what you know
options.get: 60 clout and a friend at the 114½

outcomes.text: Bev writes it all on a napkin. 'You didn't say this.' Two days later the scooters are back on their owners' porches.

later.text: Remember the scooter napkin? Bev waves you past the long line at the precinct coffee drive. 'Civic hero. Don't let it go to your head.'

outcomes.text: Bev nods, the scooters come back, and your scooter guy stops answering your texts. Worth it, mostly.

options.label: Warn the scooter guy instead
options.get: C$350 thank-you from the scooter guy

outcomes.text: The scooters vanish overnight. Your guy sends C$350 and a scooter emoji. Bev finishes her coffee slowly.

later.text: Remember tipping off the scooter guy? Bev found the scooters, and your texts. Two hours on the good bench.

options.label: 'I don't know any scooter guys'
options.cost: A free coffee you now feel weird about

outcomes.text: 'Sure you don't.' Bev pays for both coffees anyway, which is somehow worse.

title: Rev. Mercy: 'The food pantry needs someone who can talk a store manager out of anything. That's you, child.'

options.label: Hustle for the pantry
options.cost: 15 Energy and an afternoon of free talking

outcomes.text: You talk three grocery managers out of their 'expired' pallets. The pantry is full by sunset. Rev. Mercy calls it a miracle; you call it Tuesday.

later.text: Remember the pantry pallets? Rev. Mercy named you in Sunday's announcements. Half of Astoria now thinks you're a deacon.

options.label: Hustle, and keep a cut of the pallets

outcomes.text: The pantry gets most of it. A few cases of the good coffee find their way to a bodega. C$280, and a sermon about loaves.

title: Pablo's nephew wants in on your kind of work. Pablo shrugs: 'He listens to you. Your call.'

options.label: Talk him into the night classes
options.get: 45 clout and one kid who stays out of it
options.cost: C$150 for his first semester's books
options.riskWhy: Kids listen to people who did it

outcomes.text: You buy the books and give the speech you never got. He rolls his eyes, then enrols. Pablo pours you something without asking.

later.text: Remember Pablo's nephew? B+ on his first exam. Pablo knocks C$200 off whatever you owe him, which you didn't know you owed.

options.label: Put him to work as your runner
options.get: C$300 a week in saved legwork
options.cost: A kid's first job is with you

outcomes.text: He's fast, he's cheap, he's thrilled. You clear C$300 in saved legwork the first week.

later.text: Remember Pablo's nephew? He bragged to his teacher about his 'boss.' His mother has questions, and so does Sgt. Bev.

title: Jojo's card reader double-charged a whole morning. Nobody's noticed. Jojo whispers: 'You'd keep it, right?'

options.label: Help Jojo refund every one
options.cost: 10 Energy and C$640 of easy money

outcomes.text: Forty-one refunds, one by one. A regular comes back to tip you both. Jojo: 'Who even are you today?'

later.text: Remember the double charges? A customer left a five-star review naming you. Grind & Gossip framed it.

outcomes.text: C$320 each. Jojo looks thrilled for about an hour, then guilty for a week.

later.text: Remember the double charges? A regular checked his statement. Jojo refunded everyone and docked your next shift's tips.
